Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

scientometricsInR 0.2.0

New features

  • rake_keywords() ranks keyword phrases of one document with Rapid Automatic Keyword Extraction (RAKE) degree/frequency scores.
  • fetch_openalex() gains offline (default: SCIENTOMETRICS_OFFLINE=1) to reuse existing caches without any network request; missing or unreadable caches fail explicitly.

Behaviour changes

  • fetch_openalex() now caches in the session’s temporary directory by default instead of _freeze/openalex_cache in the working directory. Set the scientometricsInR.cache_dir option, as the book does, or cache_dir for a persistent cache.
  • fetch_openalex() checks its arguments, retries failed requests, never caches empty or failed provider responses and replaces cache files atomically.
  • build_coauth_graph() identifies authors by their stable OpenAlex IDs (current, legacy and flattened authorships layouts), stores display names in the label and display_name vertex attributes and weights edges by the number of distinct jointly authored works.
  • theme_sci() uses the font set in the sci.pdf_family option by default.

Documentation

  • All exported functions have runnable examples and documented return values.
  • The bundled datasets are documented together in ?teaching_data as synthetic teaching fixtures, not observed OpenAlex records.

Package infrastructure

  • The source package contains only the R package; the book’s sources, outputs and tooling are excluded from the build.
  • The OpenAlex network test is skipped on CRAN and when offline.
  • Maintainer e-mail changed to raban.heller@uni-ulm.de.
  • GitHub Actions run R CMD check on macOS, Windows and Ubuntu (R-devel, release and the previous release); the pkgdown site build has its own workflow.

scientometricsInR 0.1.0

  • Initial version accompanying the first edition of the book, with fetch_openalex(), dedupe_by_doi(), compute_h_index(), field_normalize(), compute_mncs(), build_coauth_graph(), kleinberg_bursts(), palette_sci(), theme_sci() and three synthetic teaching datasets.
